title: Origin story: Kintaro
description: Kintaro was raised in the mountains of Ashigara by a mountain witch, growing up wrestling bears and befriending animals. His impossible strength as a child — uprooting trees, riding bears — brought him to the attention of the shogun's retainer, and he became the loyal samurai Sakata no Kintoki.
